@name: Doctor
@slug: doctor
@source: character_law
@category: RMFRP Core
@default_cost: 29
@description:
 [Vocational] A doctor is a person dedicated to tending to the sick. This
 should include all types of persons who are caring for the sick, not just
 those that actually perform the healing (e.g., the nurses, attendants, etc.).
 Most people who tend to the sick are doing so on a voluntary basis. Time to
 Acquire: 18 months. Starting Money: normal.
